beginner-tips-step-1.alt: Diagram of the two PS5 menu paths to check before launch: Settings > Storage and Control Center > Downloads/Uploads, with the 212 GB free-space advice.

beginner-tips-step-2.alt: Diagram: the wanted level uses six stars.

beginner-tips-step-3.alt: Schematic map pins: a mission marker with a fast-car pin parked beside it.

editions-prices-step-1.alt: Table of GTA 6 prices: Standard $79.99, £69.99, €79.99; Ultimate $99.99, £89.99, €99.99; Ultimate Edition Upgrade $20.00 on the Xbox Store.

editions-prices-step-3.alt: Diagram of the Xbox path to claim the free GTA+ month: Store, profile icon at top left, Offers & credits.

gta-6-online-step-1.alt: Table: single-player is confirmed; an online mode is not announced.

gta-6-online-step-2.alt: Diagram: for now GTA 6 is single-player only.

gta-6-online-step-3.alt: Diagram: GTA+ is Rockstar's paid monthly club.

jason-lucia-step-2.alt: Diagram: two playable leads that you can switch between.

jason-lucia-step-3.alt: Table of three systems: switching leads, the six-star wanted level, and the Criminal Profile reputation system.

launch-night-checklist-step-1.alt: Diagram of where to check that the GTA VI download has finished on PS5 and Xbox.

launch-night-checklist-step-2.alt: Diagram of the PS5 and Xbox menu paths to read free storage space, with the 212 GB advice.

launch-night-checklist-step-3.alt: Diagram of the PS5 menu paths that turn on Auto-Install in Rest Mode and Stay Connected to the Internet.

launch-night-checklist-step-4.alt: Checklist of six launch night steps: finish the download, keep 212 GB free, turn on updates, check your account, charge your controller, check the countdown.

leonida-step-1.alt: Our own sketch with six numbered regions of Leonida. Names are on the guide page. Not to scale and not a real map.

leonida-step-2.alt: Diagram: the guide names nine places. Their map positions are not known yet, so no map is shown.

leonida-step-3.alt: Diagram: 170+ animal species in three groups, hurricanes in the game, and local weather.

map-step-2.alt: Our own sketch with six numbered regions of Leonida, names to be added once confirmed. Not to scale.

map-step-3.alt: Legend of four pin types planned for our interactive map: shops, garages, collectibles and activities.

platforms-step-1.alt: Table of platforms: native on PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and S; Xbox One by cloud streaming only; not on PS4; PC not announced.

platforms-step-3.alt: Diagram: one voice language (English) and twelve text languages on PlayStation.

preload-size-step-1.alt: Diagram of the PS5 menu path to check free space: Home screen, Settings, Storage.

preload-size-step-2.alt: Diagram of the Xbox menu path to check free space.

preload-size-step-4.alt: Diagram of the PS5 settings that let a download continue in Rest Mode.

ps5-settings-step-1.alt: Table comparing PS5 and PS5 Pro: both target 30 FPS; only PS5 Pro has PSSR and ray-traced shadows; graphics modes are not announced.

ps5-settings-step-2.alt: Diagram of the PS5 menu path to check free space.

ps5-settings-step-3.alt: Diagram: DualSense haptics and adaptive triggers can be adjusted in accessibility settings.

radio-stations-step-1.alt: Table of the six announced stations with their music and named hosts.

radio-stations-step-2.alt: Diagram: listening on foot with earbuds linked to a phone.

radio-stations-step-3.alt: Table of two music releases: the album on 19 Nov 2026 and the score on 11 Dec 2026.

release-time-step-1.alt: Table of the unlock order from New Zealand (12:00 CET on Wed 18 Nov) to the US East Coast (06:00 CET on Thu 19 Nov).

release-time-step-4.alt: Table: midnight Eastern equals 11 PM Central, 10 PM Mountain, 9 PM Pacific and 06:00 CET.

vintage-vice-city-pack-step-1.alt: Table of the four things in the Vintage Vice City Pack: a car, a garage, outfits and hairstyles, and a weapon pattern.

vintage-vice-city-pack-step-3.alt: Diagram of the Xbox path to the GTA+ offer: Store, profile icon, Offers & credits.
